item.tib: rdzogs chen mkha' 'gro'i snying thig las sdig can btsan thabs sangs rgyas thabs 'pho ba tshad med mda' mo yod
item.coloph: ces rdzogs pa chen po mkha' 'gro'i snying thig dgongs pa rang grol gyi rgyud las/ 'pho ba tshad med mda' mo 'di ni/ shar rong rnam dag bkod pa'i zhing khams dga' ldan g.yung drung gling du grogs dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgyes su kun grol grags pa bdag gis/ sa rta zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes la sug bris su byas so//
